warning.titlePre: Range Rover Vogue Timing Chain & Injector Wear
paragraphs: Range Rover Vogue engines — TDV6, SDV6, TDV8 and SDV8, across the L322 and L405 generations — commonly show timing chain and injector wear over time. This is a well-documented pattern across Land Rover specialist forums and independent garages. We replace the timing chain assembly, injector seals, and gaskets as standard on every rebuild.
